import sys

def year_university_admission(n, arr):
    total = sum(arr)
    return total // n

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    years = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    result = year_university_admission(n, years)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
